record: approval of R4 protocol v1 amendment 1 (H3)
approved_by: project owner (decisions given in the owner's instruction 'R4 H3 - Owner Approval and Campaign Release Preparation', 2026-10-28; record written by the AI assistant on the owner's instruction)

decisions.AMB-14: nominal P1-designed fixed-LQR gain across all sensitivity draws; within each draw B0 and B3 use the same gain and the same plant realisation; no per-draw retuning
decisions.AMB-15: separate official campaign directory R4_20261028_campaign/ with its own release package, gate record and manifest
decisions.AMB-24: the quasi-static check is diagnostic; the dynamic run's frozen protocol 8.2 checks determine formal feasibility; infeasible or incomplete cases receive no paired energy-saving result
decisions.S2: held-out role preserved; its outcomes are not used to tune the planner, select parameters, revise tolerances or choose a planner design
decisions.D1-D5: as stated in the released amendment, sections 1-5

tolerance_notes.I_over_protocol_abs_As: a chosen numerical-comparison tolerance set relative to the 0.01 A s pass/fail threshold of protocol 8.2; not a measured physical uncertainty and not a change of that threshold

accepted_review_items_text.CR-A6 residual: accepted as a limitation: the independent evaluator checks accounting, integration and metric definitions but does not independently validate the physical plant model; the separate torque-limit calculation reduces shared-code errors but still shares model equations and parameters

scope: protocol amendment only; this record does not authorise campaign execution
campaign_status: BLOCKED pending release-gate completion and a separate owner campaign authorisation (release/campaign_authorization.json)
